Across technology, data, AI, cyber, product, digital experience, architecture and infrastructure, TDAV combines the scale and investment of an industry leader, access to leading-edge technologies and the opportunity to help shape how a world-class financial services company competes in the AI era - all backed by the stability and purpose of a mutual company built to last.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Product Analytics Lead is a high-impact role responsible for shaping product strategy and improving
  
customer and business outcomes through data. This individual will serve as a dedicated analytics partner to product and executive leadership, bringing structure, rigor, and clarity to complex product decisions.

The role translates product vision and customer needs into measurable goals, analytical roadmaps,
  
experiments, and actionable recommendations. It connects insights across the product lifecycle, from
  
opportunity discovery and prioritization through launch, adoption, engagement, and ongoing optimization.

  

**What You'll Do:**
  
*Product Strategy and Opportunity Framing*
  
• Translate product vision, customer needs, and ambiguous business questions into clear problem
  
statements, hypotheses, and measurable outcomes.
  
• Partner with product leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to identify customer pain points, size
  
opportunities, refine scope, and prioritize the product roadmap.
  
• Define product success measures, including north-star metrics, input metrics, guardrails, and decision
  
criteria.
  
*Product Analytics and Insight Generation*  
• Lead end-to-end product analysis across discovery, development, launch, adoption, engagement,
  
retention, and value realization.
  
• Integrate product behavioral data with customer, operational, financial, and market data to create a holistic view of product performance.
  
• Build segmentation, funnel, cohort, journey, and driver analyses that reveal friction points and opportunities for improvement.
  
• Apply iterative analytical approaches to test hypotheses, deepen customer understanding, and refine
  
product recommendations.
  
*Experimentation and Product Optimization*
  
• Partner with product, design, and engineering teams to design experiments and establish sound
  
measurement plans before launch.
  
• Evaluate feature and experience changes using A/B testing, quasi-experimental methods, and other
  
appropriate techniques.
  
• Turn experiment results and post-launch performance into clear recommendations for scaling, iterating, or
  
retiring product capabilities.
  
• Create rapid learning loops that help teams make evidence-based trade-offs and continuously improve the
  
customer experience.
  
*Product Measurement and Data Foundations*  
• Own the product measurement framework and ensure metrics are clearly defined, consistently interpreted,
  
and tied to customer and business value.
  
• Partner with engineering and data teams to improve event instrumentation, data quality, semantic
  
consistency, and analytical usability.
  
• Develop scalable dashboards and self-service decision tools while reserving deep-dive analysis for the
  
highest-value product questions.
  
• Promote responsible use of data, including appropriate governance, privacy, and controls throughout the
  
product lifecycle.
  
*Executive and Product Communication*  
• Synthesize findings into concise, decision-oriented narratives for product and senior leadership.
  
• Translate complex analysis into product implications, customer impact, risks, trade-offs, and
  
recommended actions.
  
• Facilitate product reviews, roadmap discussions, and working sessions with clear evidence and a strong
  
point of view.
  
*Ways of Working*  
• Customer-centered: starts with customer needs, behaviors, and outcomes.
  
• Product-minded: balances desirability, viability, feasibility, and risk when framing recommendations.
  
• Highly iterative: develops insights through cycles of discovery, experimentation, measurement, and
  
refinement.
  
• Cross-functional: collaborates closely with product management, design, engineering, data, analytics,
  
operations, and business stakeholders.
  
• Outcome-oriented: focuses on measurable product and customer impact rather than analysis or feature
  
delivery alone.
  
• Agile and responsive: supports planned roadmap priorities and emerging product decisions.

  

**What You'll Bring:**
  
• 6-10+ years in product analytics, product management, data science, strategy, consulting, or a related field.
  
• Experience influencing product strategy and roadmap decisions through customer insight, analytics, and
  
experimentation.
  
• Experience working on complex, ambiguous product problems with senior stakeholders and cross
  
functional teams.
  
• Background in financial services, insurance, or another regulated industry is preferred.
  
• Strong understanding of product discovery, product development, lifecycle measurement, and outcome
  
based prioritization.
  
• Advanced analytical toolkit, including SQL, Python or R, experimentation, statistics, and data visualization.
  
• Experience with product analytics methods such as funnels, cohorts, segmentation, retenti

jobs.description:
The Business Marketing Group connects businesses with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger to help them grow their businesses through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, and more. We succeed when we help our customers grow their business leveraging our solutions. The Global Marketing Operations team runs campaign execution for business marketing, launching hundreds of campaigns a year across an expanding set of digital marketing channels.We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager who executes campaigns AI-first, pairing deep expertise in marketing execution platforms with the AI skills to automate that work. This role is about owning operational quality by setting executional standards that can be built at agent scale. The ideal candidate is a digital marketing expert who has already replaced meaningful parts of their own workflow with AI and can show what it produced.  
  
  

### **Marketing Operations Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own campaign execution and execution quality for an assigned business area, from brief through launch, across lifecycle, email, in-product messaging, web, and Meta ads
* Use AI as the primary tool for execution work, including build specification, copy and asset variants, audience logic, and QA
* Build, configure, and test AI agents that execute campaign workflows, and own the automation roadmap for the area, reporting results in turnaround time, cost, and error rate
* Pilot new delivery capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like and the eval rubrics that hold agents to it
* Advise partners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and translate execution learnings into platform requirements
* Raise the AI capability of the team through documentation, enablement, and coaching
* Find new ways to continually streamline execution processes, including working with XFNs (if needed) to automate handoff

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, or marketing automation
* Hands-on build experience in at least two digital marketing channels among email, paid social, in-product messaging, web, and SEM or display, with expert-level depth in at least one execution or ads platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot, Adobe)
* Demonstrated use of AI to produce real marketing work output, with specific examples of what was automated and the measured effect on time, cost, quality, or volume
* Hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating AI agents or LLM-based workflows, including prompt iteration and judgment on where output requires human review
* Experience owning campaign execution at portfolio scale, including QA and trade-off decisions across competing requests
* Experience scaling impact beyond own execution, through standards others adopted, requirements platform teams built, and enablement that raised team capability
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience in digital marketing

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience connecting AI tools to marketing systems through APIs, integrations, or agent tooling
* SQL fluency or comparable data skills, sufficient to validate audiences and interrogate campaign performance independently
* Comfort working in ambiguity, where the standard does not exist yet and part of the job is writing it

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Ads Brand Innovation Lab
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Ads is the earth's most customer-centric advertising business — and the Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) is where its most ambitious creative bets come to life. BIL conceptualizes and executes bespoke advertising experiences across the full Amazon publisher landscape, turning brands' boldest ideas into award-winning campaigns that deliver measurable business results and reshape the perception of Amazon Ads globally.  
  
As a Sr. Financial Analyst, you'll operate at the intersection of creativity and financial rigor — delivering the analysis, reporting, and financial models that shape how a world-class creative organization invests, scales, and measures success. You'll partner directly with creative, product, and tech teams, translating complex data into clear recommendations that accelerate decision-making. You'll build financial models that address difficult business questions, proactively dive deep into performance drivers, and take ownership of projects that improve how BIL operates.  
  
If you are energized by working alongside teams that are redefining what advertising can be, this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Partner with cross-functional teams to support investment and resource allocation decisions through data-driven analysis
* Drive financial planning and analysis including quarterly forecasting, annual planning, and monthly actuals and variance reporting for business revenue and operating expenses
* Manage business performance metrics, helping to identify root causes behind variances, explain financial implications, and facilitate actions that drive operational improvement
* Coordinate and facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly business review mechanisms, ensuring reporting accuracy and clear communication of results
* Lead projects to automate, simplify, or scale finance processes, including leveraging AI-enabled tools to reduce defects and boost productivity
* Build and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and team tools that facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration

  
A day in the life  
Your morning starts with reviewing financial performance, diving deep into a variance that surfaced overnight and preparing a clear explanation for your business partner. Mid-morning, you're pressure-testing assumptions in a financial model you built to support a resource allocation decision for a new initiative. After lunch, you join a cross-functional working session with creative and sales leads to walk them through a financial analysis, fielding questions and sharpening the recommendation. You close the day by improving an automated reporting workflow that saves your team hours of manual reconciliation each month.  
  
About the team  
Our Finance team works closely with BIL and other Ads teams to analyze performance, validate financial results of investments and advertising business growth initiatives, and drive controllership across the organization

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
* 3+ years of experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results, or experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis
* 3+ years of experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis

----------------------------

* 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
* MBA, or CPA
* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
* Experience in online advertising, marketing, sales or digital media

jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

Federal Reserve Bank of New YorkWhen you work at the New York Fed, you have the opportunity to make an impact in our communities and across the nation. Our mission-driven, curious, and dedicated colleagues apply their diverse perspectives and unique talents to support the strength of the U.S. economy and stability of the global financial system. At the Bank, we work full-time onsite with our teams. We believe being physically together allows us to draw on our collective strengths, while recognizing that the ability to work flexibly from time to time remains important to achieving our mission.

**Our Unique Work:**

The Markets Group of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York implements monetary policy on behalf of the Federal Reserve System, executes lender of last resort operations for depository institutions in the Second District, provides payments and custody services to foreign central banks and international monetary authorities, and serves as fiscal agent for the U.S. Treasury.

The Product, Strategy & Support team collaborates with Markets leadership to support business strategy development, define the strategic vision for the Markets Group's technology products, and ensure the portfolio of initiatives aligns with and delivers value against the Group's mission and objectives. The team ensures delivered functionality meets user needs, drives adoption that maximizes benefit, and ensures reliable support throughout the product lifecycle.

The Markets Transformation program is a multi-year Markets strategic effort evolving our trading and foreign customer banking business technology to effectively support monetary policy implementation, global financial stability, and the role of the US Dollar as the global reserve currency.

The Product Analyst for Markets Transformation supports an agile product team throughout the product lifecycle—from inception through retirement—performing industry, business, and technical analysis; contributing to product strategy, roadmaps, and prioritization; defining features and quality standards; and ensuring business value is realized through continuous user feedback.  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact as a Product Analyst:**

* Work with Product Owners and delivery squads to deliver products in the Post Trade & Custody space
* Contribute to product vision and roadmaps with measurable outcomes; align with technology partners on Markets Transformation interdependencies
* Develop messaging and communication artifacts on product strategy and delivery progress for stakeholder briefings
* Define feature requirements, user stories, prioritization, and sequencing; coordinate product demos and user feedback sessions
* Bring a structured approach to framing decision points for consistent evaluation across the program and with stakeholders
* Design and execute UAT approach and scripts; provide oversight through deployment planning
* Support planning for interim states and legacy product retirement; coordinate across product owners, architecture, vendors, operations, and business users
* Drive adoption of product features; provide training, onboarding, and ongoing usage guidance
* Monitor and communicate product-specific operational KPIs; surface insights for improvement
* Promote agile behaviors and serve as a trusted advisor to Product Owners and Product Managers

**The Unique Skill Sets We’re Looking For:**

* Product analyst experience with exposure to product ownership in financial services, including core transactional systems
* Proven ability delivering in high-profile, complex stakeholder landscapes
* Excel – Advanced proficiency (pivot tables, formulas, data analysis)
* SQL – Able to write/interpret queries for data analysis and validation
* AI Tools – Practical use of AI to improve efficiency and outcomes
* Agile Business Analysis – Skilled at gathering requirements and documenting business processes within Agile frameworks
* Cross-Functional Communication – Able to bridge requirements discussions between technical product squads and business stakeholders
* UAT – Experience planning, coordinating, and executing user acceptance testing

The right mixture of great ideas and funding can create change. In a complex organization, allocating funding to where it can be most effective can be challenging. As a financial analyst on our team, you’ll create a financial management strategy to help the client’s ammunition acquisition and life cycle by leading cost analysis efforts. You’ll work directly with the client to develop an actionable plan to determine the total resource requirements needed to achieve their goals.

Using your knowledge of laws, regulations, and policies, you’ll help your client develop well-formed requirements. Once the funding is in place, you’ll make sure the funding is used efficiently through consistent tracking and communication with the client team.

Work with us as we help fuel our countries Army with the funding they need.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

**Job Summary:**

The AI Data Analyst transforms business questions and complex data into trusted analyses, dashboards, predictive insights, and responsible AI-enabled solutions. This role combines analytics, reporting, visualization, and emerging AI technologies to improve operational efficiency and business performance. The ideal candidate is a recent Master’s graduate or early-career professional who is passionate about data, technology, and solving business challenges in a growing biopharmaceutical company.

**Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business leaders across functional areas to understand business objectives, identify opportunities for data-driven decision making, and translate business questions into actionable analytical solutions.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and risks that support operational, commercial, financial, and strategic initiatives across the organization.
* Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools to provide meaningful insights to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Collect, cleanse, validate, and integrate data from multiple internal and external sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting and analytics solutions.
* Utilize SQL, Python, and other analytical tools to perform ad hoc analyses, automate reporting processes, improve data accessibility, and support business performance monitoring.
* Support forecasting, trend analysis, scenario planning, and performance measurement initiatives by applying statistical and quantitative techniques to business data.
* Collaborate with Information Technology, Commercial, Market Access, Finance, Human Resources, Manufacturing, Quality, and other departments to support enterprise reporting and analytical initiatives.
* Assist in the evaluation, development, and implementation of artificial intelligence and automation solutions that improve efficiency, enhance decision making, and streamline business processes.
* Explore emerging technologies, advanced analytics methodologies, and AI tools to identify innovative opportunities that create measurable business value.
* Present analytical findings, recommendations, and business insights to technical and non-technical audiences through clear visualizations, executive summaries, and presentations.
* Participate in data governance, data quality, privacy, security, and compliance initiatives to ensure the integrity and responsible use of company information and AI-enabled solutions.
* Maintain documentation of data sources, methodologies, assumptions, and reporting processes to support transparency, consistency, and knowledge sharing across the organization.

**Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field preferred. Bachelor's degree with exceptional relevant experience will also be considered.
* Approximately 1 to 3 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related field. Relevant internships, co-ops, research projects, and graduate-level work may be considered toward experience requirements.
* Experience delivering analyses, dashboards, or data products that influence business decisions and are used by nontechnical stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, generative AI, or advanced analytics to practical business problems.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, medical device, manufacturing, or another regulated industry is preferred.

  

**This role is based in Warren, New Jersey, with work arrangements, travel expectations, and onsite requirements established based on business needs and company policy.**

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

#### **What is the Developer Led Growth (DLG) Team?**

At the heart of our mission is a simple goal: to make choosing and integrating authentication a delightful experience for every developer.

We're the **DLG team**; essentially Product Led Growth (PLG), but for developers using Auth0. We're a high-impact, multidisciplinary engine spanning **Developer Relations, Developer Marketing, our Startup Program, and Product Activation and Conversion**. We move metrics and build the journey that turns curious developers into lifelong advocates.

#### **Why This Role?**

**This role sits within the DLG team as part of a two-person data team,** where you'll have an experienced tech lead as your analytical partner, giving you both the autonomy to own your domain and the support to go deep on hard problems. The DLG team moves fast across many fronts, and this role is the analytical voice that keeps everyone aligned on key metrics. That means your ability to communicate clearly, whether you're presenting to a VP, syncing with a data engineer, or writing a Slack message that makes a complex finding land, this matters as much as your technical skills.

**You'll have real autonomy and a clear voice in what gets built.** Requests come from every direction across the DLG org, and while your tech lead manages the overall roadmap, you'll have genuine input into prioritization decisions and the freedom to push back when scope isn't right. As you grow in the role, so does your ownership. This is a place where strong opinions and good judgment get rewarded.

**You'll ask questions nobody else is asking.** The best work on this team doesn't come from running the report that was requested, it comes from finding the insight nobody thought to look for. We want someone who is genuinely curious and brings creative thinking to how they frame problems.

**You'll work at the frontier of AI-assisted analytics.** We're a team that actively uses AI tooling to move faster and think bigger. We expect you to use AI as a force multiplier, in how you write SQL, explore data, prototype models, and document your work.

**Responsibilities**

* Own prioritization of your analytics roadmap: scope requests, push back when needed, and make transparent tradeoffs about where your time goes

* Help the team automate and scale processes using **AI tools**, custom **SQL**, and creative approaches to reduce manual work

* **Communication and stakeholder management** - You can explain a complex data finding to a non-technical executive and a data engineer on the same day and land differently with each. You write clearly, listen well, and are comfortable pushing back when requirements aren't scoped correctly.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Python

* Translating developer behavior into product insights

* Revenue modeling and forecasting

**GIS Data & Integration**

**GIS Automation**

**GIS Platform Support**

new_jobs.description:
AI Operations | Managed AI Services | Full-Time, Exempt
  
ECI is seeking an AI Operations Analyst to serve as the operational front door for AI across its client base. This role helps clients adopt, operate, govern, and expand their use of approved enterprise AI platforms while ensuring each request is connected to the right technical guidance, governance path, and service engagement.
  
  
About ECI
  
ECI is building a dedicated AI Operations capability to help regulated organizations operate AI successfully and responsibly at scale. The AI Operations Analyst will work alongside engineers, governance specialists, adoption consultants, business development, and client-facing teams while helping shape ECI's managed AI operations discipline.
  
Position Summary
  
The AI Operations Analyst owns AI-related requests from intake through outcome confirmation, coordinating work across internal teams and maintaining clear client communication. The role combines technical support, client advisory, use-case discovery, governance awareness, and service coordination. Success requires understanding the business need behind each request, translating technical concepts into practical guidance, and engaging the appropriate specialists when broader value or deeper expertise is required.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Serve as the primary intake point for AI-related incidents, requests, advisory questions, changes, and operational needs, maintaining ownership through confirmed resolution or outcome.
* Classify, prioritize, document, and coordinate work through established service-management processes and provide proactive communication to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Provide operational support for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Anthropic Claude Enterprise, OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot Studio, approved agents and connectors, and future approved AI platforms.
* Support licensing, entitlements, user access, group membership, troubleshooting, configuration validation, feature guidance, prompt assistance, and agent triage.
* Determine when a request can be resolved through a standard procedure and when AI Engineering, Security Operations, Infrastructure, AI Deployment, AI Adoption, AI Governance, or another specialist team should be engaged.
* Engage clients to understand the business objective behind technical requests and connect needs to relevant AI use cases, productivity goals, adoption requirements, and operational outcomes.
* Provide guidance on documented platform capabilities, limitations, and best practices, and participate in discovery discussions when technical context is needed.
* Recognize opportunities for AI Adoption, AI Governance, AI Engineering, AI Deployment, managed AI services, or related project work, and introduce the appropriate ECI leader or delivery specialist.
* Identify data protection, responsible AI, security, compliance, shadow AI, prompt-injection, and data-exposure concerns and route them through the correct escalation process.
* Maintain knowledge articles, runbooks, and standard operating procedures; track recurring support patterns and release impacts; and recommend automation, self-service, and service improvements.

Required Qualifications
  

* Three to seven years of experience in technical account management, customer success engineering, managed services operations, solutions engineering, Microsoft 365 administration, IT service delivery, SaaS support, or enterprise technical support.
* Demonstrated success in a client-facing technical role and experience using an IT service-management platform such as ServiceNow.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Copilot, Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms, SaaS administration, licensing, single sign-on, SCIM, conditional access, and ITIL service-management concepts.
* Foundational understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, data protection, security, and operational risk.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business language, uncover requirements through discovery conversations, and coordinate effectively across technical and client-facing teams.
* Excellent written communication, documentation, analytical, escalation-management, and knowledge-authoring skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102), Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900), or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Experience with Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Purview, Defender for Cloud Apps, or Microsoft Power Platform.
* Exposure to AI governance frameworks or responsible AI programs.
* Experience supporting financial services or another regulated industry.

ECI’s culture is all about connection - connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and the base salary for this role is $125,000 plus flexible PTO, health benefit eligibility the first of the month, life insurance, pet insurance, 401K and so much more! If you believe you’d be a great fit and are ready for your best job ever, we’d like to hear from you!!
  
Love Your Job, Share Your Technology Passion, Create Your Future Here!
  
ECI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration consistent with applicable law.

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Ads is the earth's most customer-centric advertising business — and the Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) is where its most ambitious creative bets come to life. BIL conceptualizes and executes bespoke advertising experiences across the full Amazon publisher landscape, turning brands' boldest ideas into award-winning campaigns that deliver measurable business results and reshape the perception of Amazon Ads globally.  
  
As a Sr. Financial Analyst, you'll operate at the intersection of creativity and financial rigor — delivering the analysis, reporting, and financial models that shape how a world-class creative organization invests, scales, and measures success. You'll partner directly with creative, product, and tech teams, translating complex data into clear recommendations that accelerate decision-making. You'll build financial models that address difficult business questions, proactively dive deep into performance drivers, and take ownership of projects that improve how BIL operates.  
  
If you are energized by working alongside teams that are redefining what advertising can be, this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Partner with cross-functional teams to support investment and resource allocation decisions through data-driven analysis
* Drive financial planning and analysis including quarterly forecasting, annual planning, and monthly actuals and variance reporting for business revenue and operating expenses
* Manage business performance metrics, helping to identify root causes behind variances, explain financial implications, and facilitate actions that drive operational improvement
* Coordinate and facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly business review mechanisms, ensuring reporting accuracy and clear communication of results
* Lead projects to automate, simplify, or scale finance processes, including leveraging AI-enabled tools to reduce defects and boost productivity
* Build and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and team tools that facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration

  
A day in the life  
Your morning starts with reviewing financial performance, diving deep into a variance that surfaced overnight and preparing a clear explanation for your business partner. Mid-morning, you're pressure-testing assumptions in a financial model you built to support a resource allocation decision for a new initiative. After lunch, you join a cross-functional working session with creative and sales leads to walk them through a financial analysis, fielding questions and sharpening the recommendation. You close the day by improving an automated reporting workflow that saves your team hours of manual reconciliation each month.

Our Finance team works closely with BIL and other Ads teams to analyze performance, validate financial results of investments and advertising business growth initiatives, and drive controllership across the organization

As digital threats continue to evolve and threaten businesses large and small, bad actors are improving their tactics, techniques and procedures faster than corporate security teams can keep up. Increasingly organized and collaborative, their methods grow more sophisticated each year. Our clients continually look to EY for our knowledge and resources to assist with their Digital Investigations & Privacy needs.

  

**The opportunity**

The nature of this role means no two projects will be the same. You will balance your time between directly liaising with our clients to understand their situation and create an appropriate investigation plan to perform technical review and analysis of data. This will include investigating what happened and helping the client to determine the potential impact and how the company’s data was potentially misused. You will be helping clients assess and resolve insider threats on an ongoing basis for multiple clients at a time. That means thinking differently about the type of data misuse, identifying malicious insiders, improving the client’s data integrity, investigation methodology and mitigate privacy risks.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Desire to constantly develop your understanding of our clients’ industries, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for improvement

* Ability to communicate technical events and analysis to both technical and nontechnical audiences and an understanding of the potential legal impacts
* Ability to preserve network and host-based digital evidence in an industry accepted forensically sound manner
* Experience performing host-based digital forensics on Microsoft Windows and Mac based systems using both Windows and Linux based forensic tools
* Experience performing mobile-based digital forensics on Apple and Android based systems

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* A bachelor's degree in business, technology entrepreneurship, computer science, informatics, statistics, applied mathematics, data science or related field
* 1+ years relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CFE, CFCE, RCA or EnCE
* Effective project and time management skills and the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements

* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* In-depth understanding of computer forensic principles including digital and mobile forensics, log analysis, cloud-based systems, database structures, querying languages and common digital forensics tools
* Knowledge of data loss prevention systems and how they detect potential host and network-based data loss technologies or other insider threat risks
* Knowledge of Windows, Unix and Mac host-based forensics, Mobile OS’s and command line
* Global client network, experience working with fortune 500 companies, international and frequent travel opportunities
* Working knowledge of hardware configuration and network/data communications, software development and scripting, and database technology and database exploitation/forensics
* Experience with evidence seizure, chain of custody and conducting analysis

We’re interested in passionate analysts, with the intellectual curiosity to actively pursue new knowledge in the rapidly changing world of digital forensics. new_jobs.title: Senior Policy Analyst, Tobacco, Systems of Care
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a **Senior Policy Analyst, Systems of Care, Tobacco and Public Health** in our office located in **Washington, DC (home-based is acceptable)** .

The Senior Policy Analyst is responsible for researching, developing, writing, and reporting on an assigned policy portfolio for advocacy. Additional responsibilities include translating science and developing content for policy briefs, fact sheets, position statements, and other communications to build support for American Heart Association’s advocacy efforts at community, state, and federal levels.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

**Responsibilities**

* Translates science into policy for assigned strategic issues and policy development, supporting state/federal advocacy. Develops policy statements (published and unpublished), regulatory comments, model legislation, policy briefs, and other material to support and position the American Heart Association’s advocacy and programmatic efforts.
* Shepherds policy papers from conception to publication, interacts with writing groups, convenes experts nationally and internationally, serves as an author occasionally when applicable in areas of expertise, manages the writing process, and balances differing expert perspectives.
* Reviews and analyzes research for relevance and support of American Heart Association’s policy position.
* Contributes to and conducts policy implementation and outcome evaluation research to inform model policy development.
* Interacts with relevant government agencies and manages a certain number of external relationships with coalitions and partners aligned with the assigned advocacy portfolio. Represents the American Heart Association at conferences and meetings. Will occasionally serve as a speaker on behalf of the American Heart Association in areas of expertise
* Represents policy research by leading or participating in interdepartmental and intradepartmental working groups addressing tobacco, systems of care, and other areas as needed.
* Provides content in the areas of expertise to support the Advocacy Coordinating Committee meetings, providing materials for the agenda, presenting on certain topics and serving as a liaison with volunteers.

**Want to help get your resume to the top? Take a look at the experience we require:**

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or similar degree in Health Science, Public Policy (Healthcare), Healthcare Administration, Political Science, or equivalent experience
* 5 years of relevant experience
* Minimum of three (3) years of experience translating science and medical research outcomes into impactful public policy.
* Proficient knowledge of health policy issues including public health, health care delivery systems, and tobacco prevention and cessation.
* Effective writing and speaking skills
* Ability to develop external relationships with government agencies, national coalitions, or other potential partners for American Heart Association advocacy work
* Ability to work both independently and in a team environment
* Ability to meet deadlines amid competing project and program delivery requirements
* Ability to manage people, orient them to policy research, and provide a priority work stream
* Must be able to travel overnight approx. 10% of the time.

**Here are some of the preferred skills we are looking for:**

* MPH or Advanced graduate studies in Public Health, Healthcare Policy, Health Systems, or related areas
* Comprehensive proofreading skills and attention to detail
* Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing priorities

**Compensation & Benefits**

Expected pay range will be $100,000 - $110,000. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range.

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

* **Compensation** – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
* **Performance and Recognition** – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; based on the type of position
* **Benefits** – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.
